nightdash-bot: [ALERT] 23:01 UTC — nightly throughput dashboard: +19% drop in p95 throughput on production pool 'shared-gpu-e2'. Investigating. link: https://dash.redwood/alerts/3301012345 :warning:
Anya: saw this when I woke up. Can anyone triage quickly? Canary 2026-03-17T22:00 rolled last night.
Liam: looking. Which release/merge was the canary pinned to?
Anya: canary tag: release/23.4.2, commit: 6b3f9a2. It included batching coalescing tweak in runtime (PR #4127) and a kernel-selector tweak.
Kevin: FYI CI perf job "nightly-e2-throughput" failed on that commit earlier — logs show sustained batch sizes jumped ~2-3x and KV cache miss rate spiked. I pasted the CI snippet below.
Kevin: ```
CI: nightly-e2-throughput @6b3f9a2
metric: mean_batch_size: baseline 4.2 -> 11.8
metric: kv_cache_miss_rate: baseline 4.5% -> 18.9%
metric: p95_latency: baseline 240ms -> 410ms
exit: PERF_THRESHOLD_FAIL
```
Sasha: that matches what the flamegraphs from prod look like — more time in kernel selection and prefetch synchronization. I uploaded a sample: https://artifacts.redwood/prof/3301012345/flame.svg
Sasha: short excerpt: ```
- batch_coalescer::coalesce_loop +30% CPU
- kernel_selector::choose_candidate +20%
- kv_cache::evict_scan +25%
```
Marta: hmm coalescing threshold in #4127 was increased to reduce tiny-batch overheads for hosted bursts. It sounds like it's over-coalescing across tenants and creating large hotset churn. Maybe batching window is ignoring affinity tags.
Liam: good call. If big batches are grouping requests from many tenants, KV hotset oscillation will spike evictions. Can we confirm request affinity tags are preserved through the coalescer?
Kevin: quick grep shows PR touched coalescer and removed a stale affinity check in coalesce_policy.cpp around line 183:
```
- if (!can_coalesce(t1, t2)) return false; // affinity check
+ // intentionally removed affinity check to increase packing
```
Anya: that line reads like the smoking gun. Who approved removing it?
Marta: author was @slee in runtime-team, reviews from @kevin + @liam. Maybe they missed multi-tenant regressions in CI.
Liam: plan: 1) block further rollout of release/23.4.2 canary, 2) revert the affinity change in coalescer in a hotfix, 3) run a targeted bisect if revert unclear. Can someone flip the canary hold flag?
Sasha: I can flip hold in console now. Doing it. :white_check_mark:
Sasha: done — canary paused and traffic routed to last known good. Observability shows partial recovery within 4 minutes. p95 trending down to ~260ms.
Anya: great. Still need root cause and whether kernel-selector change amplified this. Can we bisect between 6b3f9a2 and previous good 6b2d4ff?
Liam: I can run a local bisect on the perf harness tonight. Quick bisect steps I used before:```
git bisect start 6b3f9a2 6b2d4ff
# run perf job: ./ci/run-nightly-e2.sh --iterations 3 --profile
# mark bad/good accordingly
```
Kevin: also enable runtime debug logs for kernel selection and coalescer for the bisect. There's an env flag: RUNTIME_LOG_COMPONENTS=coalescer,kernel_selector. Might add some noise, but helps confirm behavior.
Marta: can we add a short regression test in CI that asserts mean_batch_size < 8 for the shared pool? It would've caught this. I'll open a test PR after we stabilize.
Anya: agree. For now, let's do hotfix revert of the affinity removal and run a smoke staging perf job. @Liam can you prepare revert PR and @Sasha can promote to canary once staging looks good?
Liam: will open PR with revert patch in ~30m. I'll include perf harness runs in CI and post the artifact links.
Sasha: staging smoke started. ETA ~20m.
Kevin: if revert isn't enough, we should bisect kernel-selector commits next — there was a change to candidate scoring in #4119. That could increase selection churn when batches are larger.
Anya: assigning owners: Liam = revert PR + bisect runner, Sasha = hold toggle + staging promotion, Kevin = CI perf artifacts + logs, Marta = follow-up CI test. I'll create a short incident doc after this thread.
Liam: PR opened: https://git.redwood/runtime/pulls/4190 — includes the original affinity check and a unit test for coalescer. Kicked off CI.
Sasha: staging perf green: mean_batch_size 3.9, kv_miss 5.1%, p95 248ms. Looks good.
Anya: thanks team. Leaving this thread open until merge goes to prod. If anything changes ping here or escalate to oncall. :thumbsup:
nightdash-bot: [INFO] 23:59 UTC — alert resolved (canary paused, rolling back).
